{{Quote|What about a ''sideways'' attack?|[[Latts Razzi/Legends|Latts Razzi]], to [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]]|<ref name="Mandalorian Memories">{{TCWComicCite|6.41|Mandalorian Memories}}</ref>}}
A '''grappling boa''' was a weapon used by the [[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Latts Razzi/Legends|Latts Razzi]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The boa was utilized much like a whip and could be used to ensnare a target and violently hurl them about. Razzi used them successfully against some [[Kage Warriors/Legends|Kage Warriors]] on the [[Subtram/Legends|subtram]] and used again against a [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] Soldier on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].
